title: Pager hot-journal synchronization boundary

scope.rationale: pagerSyncHotJournal makes the entire hot rollback journal durable before playback and publishes the resulting file size as the synchronized journal-header boundary. This ensures a crash during rollback leaves the next recovery process with the same journal content.

external_source_responsibilities: The hot-journal owner has opened the complete rollback journal for recovery
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete sync/size/publication body and all active behavior blocks are assigned. Production hot recovery invokes it after journal open and before any playback read or database write.

inputs: Pager with an open rollback journal selected for hot recovery
outputs: Exact journal sync or size result and, on success, the synchronized byte boundary
contracts.ownership: Pager retains journal ownership. The file-size output is stack-owned and journal_header is Pager scalar state.
contracts.state_and_results: Sync occurs before size. A sync error prevents size publication. A size error prevents boundary publication. Success replaces journal_header with the exact nonnegative journal size.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the recovery lock. Journal xSync and xFileSize are dispatched synchronously; no callback is invoked.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Failure leaves the prior boundary unchanged and prevents playback. The journal remains for a later retry; successful sync allows recovery to continue.

representation_differences: The active production Pager always synchronizes rollback journals; it has no separately configurable noSync field at this boundary, so the source noSync branch is represented by the always-sync production profile.
The source stores journalHdr as i64. Zig validates the VFS size as nonnegative and stores a u64 boundary.

oracle.protocol: Open a real rollback journal, write a bounded payload, sync and verify published size; inject sync and file-size failures and verify exact result, unchanged boundary, retained journal, and successful retry before playback.
oracle.normalization: Call order, result codes, and byte sizes compare exactly.

assurance.oom: No allocation in the sync helper; preexisting journal ownership is retained.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Sync precedes boundary publication and playback under the recovery lock; injected failures preserve the hot journal for retry.
assurance.malformed_input: A negative VFS file size maps to IOERR_FSTAT and is not published.
assurance.continuation: Sync/size failure blocks playback; a later recovery can reopen and retry the same journal.
assurance.performance: One journal sync and one file-size query per hot recovery.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig hot recovery and memory_journal.Journal VFS transport
integration.native_call_path: Pager.beginRead -> recoverHotJournal -> openJournalFile -> syncHotJournal -> playbackJournal -> close/delete journal.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Hot recovery no longer begins playback without first synchronizing and publishing the complete journal boundary.

independent_review.notes: Requires scoped durable recovery-fault receipt and independent review.

known_blockers: Capture a scoped durable sync/size/playback-order receipt before internal-trace promotion.
